available_architecture.description: H2 as drawn: per-chain CAL coupler/combiner loopback plus ADTR1107 CPLR_OUT power detectors.
available_architecture.name: h2_available
available_architecture.notes: Feeds a common CAL tone into each chain coupler or samples the chain sum. Per-element phase is not observable.

audit.conclusion: The current H2 hardware cannot identify 16 independent feed complex responses. It can identify a relative complex chain common-path response at the CAL coupler and per-feed amplitude. Feed phase requires a factory/bench per-feed table, a shielded near-field probe, or an H3 per-feed switch/combiner.

findings.claim: The H2 tile has a per-chain complex CAL loopback.
evidence: hardware/H1_CLOCK_CALIBRATION.md: L3 cal coupler on each RF0..RF3 to a 4:1 combiner and CAL SMA.
hardware/h2/schematics/cal.kicad_sch: J801 'SMA CAL (inject / sample)', U801 EP4RKU+ SUM/P1..P4, CAL_SUM and CAL_INJ1..4.

findings.claim: The H2 tile does not provide per-feed complex IQ.
evidence: hardware/h2/schematics/cal.kicad_sch: only CAL_SUM/CAL_INJ1..4 connect to the 4:1 network; there is no per-feed complex receiver.
hardware/h2/schematics/bf1.kicad_sch: C1_DET1..C1_DET4 go to ADAR1000 DET1..DET4.
hardware/H1_CLOCK_CALIBRATION.md: ADTR1107 CPLR_OUT to ADAR1000 DET1-4 is amplitude only; detectors cannot do phase calibration.

hardware/h2/schematics/cal.kicad_sch: 'Per-element: ADTR1107 CPLR_OUT -> ADAR1000 DETx (power only, -20..+10 dBm). Element phase cal needs a near-field/OTA probe in a shielded setup (no OTA at 8.4 GHz).'

findings.claim: N310 chain phase is random after every start or retune.
evidence: hardware/H1_CLOCK_CALIBRATION.md: N310 phase is random between runs; chain-to-chain IF phase must be re-measured at every N310 start/retune.
hardware/h2/schematics/cal.kicad_sch: 'N310 relative channel phase is random per start/retune -> run CAL-port RX/TX loopback after every N310 init or LO retune.'

findings.claim: The H1 L1 feed layer requires a cabled VNA or reference RX per feed.
evidence: hardware/H1_CLOCK_CALIBRATION.md: L1 feed-to-feed calibration method is 'cabled VNA or reference RX per feed', stored in an MCU table.

polarization.name: assumed-cross-pol-25db
polarization.source: engineering assumption; not a measured polarization isolation

quantizer.name: adar1000-reported
quantizer.source: H1.1 reported 2.8 deg phase step, 0.5 dB gain step, >=31 dB range
